_doc: pla-02 Grimoire cleanup (director 2026-11-20; owner feedback 1): every keyword and mechanic page opens with its tooltip sentence (the glossary definition) and keeps a detail paragraph only for how-to-play help. Unit-specific exceptions, hidden caps and edge cases live on trait chips or show in the previews. These pages supersede the Grimoire bodies pinned by the tt-01/tt-02/trp-01/pla-01 fixtures. Read by tests/test_short_card_tooltips.py, tests/short_card_tooltips_test.gd, tests/card_panel_text_test.gd, tests/suites/mrk01_marked_suite.gd, tests/suites/dragon_feedback1_suite.gd and tests/suites/tooltip_consistency_suite.gd; the historical fixtures stay untouched.

basic:run: One journey through 6 sections, each ending in a dragon.
Explore rooms, win combats and claim rewards before the next boss. Held Embers stay with the run until banked, spent, recovered or lost. The run ends at the last dragon, at defeat or by Embrace.
basic:map: Revealed exits show where you can travel next. Rooms you leave are sealed behind you.

Combat, Ember Hearth, merchant, treasure, relic, and boss rooms each change the next choice. Each section is a map of rooms. Pick a forward route through combat, Relic, Scavenger, Ember Hearth and other rooms.
basic:loadout: Your loadout includes equipment, magic, items, relics and skills.
Equipment, magic and items form your deck. Change your loadout outside combat, including at an Ember Hearth.
basic:rewards: After combat, take 1 of 3 cards, or skip to heal 3.
Dragons and Guardians also give relics. A magic card you gain goes straight into your deck. Purge removes a card.
basic:relics: Passive effects that last the whole run.
Relics come from Relic rooms, dragons and Guardians. Hover a relic badge in the top HUD to see that relic's current text.
combat:board: Cards target board tiles. Each legal target meets the card's Range, line of sight, occupancy and terrain rules. Card previews show legal targets, affected tiles and projected results. Press Z to undo free Movement before you play a card. Movement that reveals or triggers something cannot be undone. Each enemy shows the damage of its next attack and its place in the turn order. Red tiles will be hit before your next turn. Press I to see each enemy's full plan.
combat:turn_clock: The unit with the lowest Time acts next, and you act first on a tie.
Playing a card adds the card's Time to the acting unit's turn delay. A beat is a battlefield rule's slot on the turn rail.
combat:card_plays: Spend 1 Card Play per card, refilling each turn and gaining 1 per kill.
Extra Card Plays expire at the end of your turn. The Card Plays counter shows your remaining Card Plays this turn.
combat:health_defense: Damage hits Block, then Stoneskin, then Health.
combat:defiance: Each Defiance charge saves you from 1 lethal hit and leaves you at 25% of your maximum Health, rounded up.
Gain 1 Defiance per 4 permanent levels at the start of a run. Reaching a milestone during a run adds the new charge. Defiance does not refill during a run.
combat:targeting: Attacks need a visible target within Range. Ranged attacks also need line of sight. A card that ignores Range or line of sight says so.

Walls and Outcrops block the line of sight required by ranged attacks. Area actions hit the tiles shown in the preview. Push and Pull move the target from or toward the source until the target reaches the distance or stops.
combat:fatigue: Drawing from an empty draw pile shuffles your discard into your draw pile and costs Health.
Each Fatigue in a combat costs 1 more Health than the last. Fatigue bypasses Block. Draw and Pass previews show the Health that Fatigue costs.
combat:traps: Traps hit when entered or attacked, then leave ground on that tile and each adjacent tile.
A trap leaves the trap's element as ground. An Air trap Pushes each adjacent unit 1 tile away instead of leaving ground.
combat:outcrops: An Outcrop blocks movement and line of sight.

Raise Outcrops on empty floor. When an Outcrop is destroyed, leave Rubble on that tile. Raising an Outcrop keeps routes connected. Outcrops raised on tiles adjacent to the target may close off the target tile. A powder keg blocks movement and leaves line of sight open. When the keg is destroyed, the keg Bursts and can destroy other kegs. When Rockburst hits an Outcrop or crate, Rockburst Bursts that terrain. Worldbreak Bursts an adjacent Outcrop you raised.
combat:lightning_strikes: This enemy hits each Marked tile, then leaves Electrified on each Marked tile.
combat:summons: This enemy adds the named enemy to combat.
The summon preview shows each arrival. The summon preview shows Summon blocked when no enemy arrives.
combat:umbra: Darkness that hides enemies and enemy intents.

The Umbra hides tiles beyond your sight. Hidden enemies show no intent and can't be targeted directly. Area attacks still hit hidden enemies in the area. Light reveals tiles within its range. Vision makes hidden enemies visible.
keyword:melee: Deal X damage to an adjacent target or a target within the card's Range.
keyword:ranged: Deal X damage to a target within Range and line of sight.
keyword:move: Ground and traps trigger on entry. Choose your tile to stay in place. Leaving Rubble costs 2 Movement instead of 1.
keyword:blink: Move to a visible open tile up to X tiles away, ignoring intervening tiles.
Ground and traps trigger on arrival. Choose your tile to stay in place. A Gloam Stalker's Fade lands on another adjacent tile if the tile behind you is blocked.
keyword:block: Block absorbs damage until the start of the holder's next turn.
keyword:stoneskin: Stoneskin absorbs damage after Block and stays until used up.
keyword:heal: Healing stops at your maximum Health.
keyword:draw: Your hand holds at most 7 cards. The Draw chip shows how many cards you will draw.
keyword:card_play: Spend 1 Card Play per card, refilling each turn and gaining 1 per kill.
Each enemy summon gives you 1 more Card Play next turn. Killing a summoned enemy gives none.
keyword:follow_up: Gain the Follow-up bonus if you already played a card this turn.
Follow-up is checked when the card starts. Your hand shows the bonus while Follow-up is active.
keyword:empower: Pay the Empower cost as you play this card to gain the Empower bonus.

Charge a card with the seal in the upper right, E, or the controller's right stick. A charged card glows until you play that card or your turn ends. Pay the Empower cost after the card resolves. Extra Time delays your next turn. Block does not prevent a Health cost. An Exhaust cost removes this card for the rest of combat.
keyword:stagger: Delay the target's next turn by X Time.
Hover a Stagger target to preview that target's new place in the turn order. Each unit takes up to 6 Stagger per turn.
keyword:illusion: A decoy with X Health that enemies target when at least as close as you.

An enemy that damages a charged Illusion takes damage once per attack. Doppelganger lets ranged attacks come from the Illusion's tile. Mirror Feint places an Illusion adjacent to an enemy. Hall of Mirrors creates an Illusion on each empty tile adjacent to you. Empty Husk swaps you with an Illusion and gives that Illusion your Block as extra Health. Shattered Reflection Bursts one of your Illusions. Swap triggers arrival effects, and Burst triggers Illusion destruction effects.
keyword:immobilize: Immobilized units can't Move, Blink or Swap on their next turn.
keyword:exhaust: This card leaves your deck until the end of combat.
keyword:retaliate: Until the holder's next turn, melee hits and hits from adjacent tiles deal X damage back.

Retaliate triggers once per enemy attack. Add Retaliate damage together and use the largest Shock and Push values. Block and Stoneskin absorb Retaliate damage. An enemy defeated by Retaliate gives the usual rewards and no Card Play. An Illusion's Retaliate triggers once per enemy attack.
keyword:rite: This card's effect lasts for the rest of combat, and this card Exhausts.
With Worldspine, at the start of your turn, each enemy adjacent to an Outcrop you raised takes 3 damage.
keyword:health_cost: Pay the Health cost when the card finishes. Block and Stoneskin don't prevent the loss.
keyword:pierce: Damage from this attack ignores Block and Stoneskin.
keyword:shock: Shocked units can't attack on their next turn.
When a card Shocks on each hit, Chain and conducted hits also Shock.
keyword:expose: The next hit that damages an Exposed unit deals X more damage.
keyword:chain: After each hit, hit 1 new target within X tiles, with Electrified tiles as relays.
Each enemy is hit at most once by Chain. Lightning cards also hit through connected Electrified tiles.
keyword:push: Move the target X tiles straight away from the source, causing a Collision if blocked.

A card Push starts from you unless the card names a tile. If the target is diagonal, the longer direction is chosen by default. Rotate to choose the other direction before you commit. In an area Push, each enemy moves straight away from the source and collides if blocked.
keyword:pull: Move the target X tiles straight toward the source, causing a Collision if blocked.

If the target is diagonal, the longer direction is chosen by default. Rotate to choose the other direction before you commit. A target that reaches the source stops without a Collision. In an area Pull, each enemy moves straight toward the source and collides if blocked.
keyword:collision: A blocked Push or Pull deals 2 damage per unmoved tile to the mover and blocker.
Walls take no damage. Block and Stoneskin absorb Collision damage.
keyword:consume: This item leaves your deck for the rest of the run once played.
keyword:illuminate: Light reveals within X tiles for the rest of combat and gives enemies starting in Light Expose 2.
keyword:vision: For X turns, each hidden enemy is visible to you.
combat:worldspines: Tharokh Marks tiles between you and Tharokh. After every second turn of yours, the Marked tiles become Outcrops. At half Health, Tharokh's Marked tiles become Outcrops after each of your turns.
A Marked tile stays flat if the unit on that tile cannot be moved to an open tile. Outcrops also block Tharokh and Burrow Grubs. Destroy an Outcrop to open a route.
combat:cinder_marks: When this attack lands, each unit on a Marked tile takes X damage, and each Marked tile becomes Fire.

Crownfire Bursts each of Vyraketh's Marked Fire tiles, then Vyraketh moves toward you and attacks. The Meteorfall card Marks tiles. At the start of your next turn, each unit on a Marked tile takes damage, and each Marked tile becomes Fire.
combat:hollow_gale: Hollow Gale damages each unit within 2 tiles of Vaeloryx, then Pushes each unit hit away.
After each Vaeloryx turn, Gust Pushes each unit 1 tile, then turns a quarter clockwise. Vaeloryx retreats before Eye of the Storm. Leave the area or move closer to take less damage.
combat:area_force: An area Push or Pull moves each enemy in the area in a straight line away from or toward the source. The source is you or the tile the card names. An enemy at the source of a Pull stays in place.

A Push starts with the farthest enemy. A Pull starts with the nearest enemy. A Collision deals 2 damage per unmoved tile to the moving unit and each blocker hit. Squall Pushes each enemy hit 2 tiles away from you.
combat:swap: Trade places with a visible enemy or one of your illusions.

Swap requires Range and line of sight. Choose an enemy that occupies 1 tile. Both units trigger ground and traps on arrival. You collect loot on the arrival tile. Anchored allows Swap. Swap causes no Collision.
combat:stances: Active stances appear as badges on your unit.
combat:cleanse: Remove the listed statuses from yourself.
Cleanse removes Immobilize or Shock at once. Removing Immobilize or Shock frees you for the rest of this turn, and a Shock cleanse can be played while Shocked.
combat:crystal_armor: Each Crystal Mantle layer prevents damage from 1 direct hit, then breaks. Ground, Collision, traps and Health costs bypass Crystal Mantle.
Each layer extends Iskaldra's Shatterstorm by 1 tile, and Shatterstorm breaks the remaining layers. Crystal Mantle cards give you layers that last until broken or combat ends.
combat:boss_eclipse: Last Eclipse hits you and your Illusions on Marked tiles, then starts Eclipse for 2 turns.
Night Coil puts out the nearest brazier. Walk or Blink onto a dark brazier's tile to relight that brazier. Light blocks Eclipse's darkness.
keyword:surface: Place the named ground on each tile in the area.
A tile holds Rubble and 1 of Fire, Ice or Electrified. Ground stays until destroyed, replaced, removed or combat ends.
keyword:surface_fire: A unit entering Fire takes 2 damage, and a unit starting on Fire takes 3.
keyword:surface_ice: A unit entering Ice or starting a turn on Ice gains Expose 2.
keyword:surface_electrified: A Lightning card's hit on an Electrified tile also hits each enemy on connected Electrified tiles.
Electrified tiles also relay Chain. Frost Circuit turns connected Ice tiles into Electrified. Discharge Bursts connected Electrified tiles.
keyword:surface_rubble: The first step is allowed if you have Movement remaining.
keyword:surface_relocate: Move the ground on one tile to another open tile.
keyword:reflect: Attacks from a non-adjacent tile bounce back to the attacker.
keyword:flying: Flying units ignore traps, ground and Collision damage.
keyword:marked: Marked tiles are hit on this enemy's next turn.
Burrowed enemies cannot be targeted or moved. Area attacks hit Burrowed enemies. A Burrow Grub emerges on the Marked tile or the nearest open tile.
keyword:charge: At 3 Charge, this enemy's next attack is Arc Lash. Shock removes 1 Charge.
This enemy gains Charge each use. Arc Lash Chains between units.
keyword:wind: On each Gust beat, each unit is Pushed downwind.
keyword:upheaval: On each Upheaval beat, Marked tiles become Outcrops and move units to free adjacent tiles.
The tile stays flat if the unit cannot be moved. Destroy an Outcrop to open a route.
keyword:burst: Destroy the target, then deal X damage on that tile and each adjacent tile.
Hover the card to see each tile the Burst hits. Kindle adds up to 4 damage to the Ember Tick's Burst.
keyword:range: How far this attack reaches in tiles, counted without diagonals.
keyword:time: Spending Time makes your next turn come later.
A card always costs at least 1 Time.
Each of your first 2 unused Card Plays adds 5 Time.
keyword:eclipse: The darkest Umbra stage, where you see only your tile and each adjacent tile.
keyword:skate: This turn, Ice costs you no Movement and doesn't Expose you.
keyword:fireproof: This turn, Fire doesn't damage you.
keyword:surface_convert: Change the chosen ground into the named ground, then damage each enemy on the changed tiles.
The card shows whether connected tiles change too.
keyword:illusion_swap: Trade places with one of your illusions.
Swap with one of your visible Illusions, anywhere unless the card shows a Range. Both units trigger ground and traps on arrival.
keyword:health: At 0 Health, a unit is defeated.
Terrain breaks at 0 Health. Your Health carries over between rooms.
keyword:terrain_burst: This enemy damages each unit adjacent to terrain this enemy raised.
keyword:detonate_cinders: This enemy Bursts the Fire on each tile from this enemy's last Cinder Marks.
keyword:guard_ally: This enemy gives X Block to each shown ally.
The enemy may also guard itself.
keyword:heal_ally: This enemy restores X Health to the named ally.
The target can be this enemy.
keyword:ember: Currency spent on wares and levels, and dropped when you die.
Earn Embers from kills and victories. Recover dropped Embers on your next run.
keyword:element_fire: Fire cards place Fire and Burst that Fire.
keyword:element_ice: Ice cards place Ice and Burst that Ice.
keyword:element_lightning: Lightning cards place Electrified and spread through Electrified tiles.
keyword:element_air: Air cards Push, Pull and move units.
keyword:element_earth: Earth cards leave Rubble, raise terrain and give Stoneskin.
keyword:skill_point: Earned by leveling up and spent on skills.
Spend Skill Points in the Character menu.
keyword:moltshard: Won from your first dragon, then traded for Embers or spent to reset your skills.
Trade 1 for 250 Embers, or spend 1 to reset your skills.
keyword:wait: Each of your first 2 unused Card Plays adds 5 Time to your next turn.
keyword:turns: How many of your turns this effect lasts.
At the start of your turn, reduce Turns by 1. The effect ends at 0. An effect marked ∞ lasts for the rest of combat.
keyword:movement: Tiles you can walk each turn for free.
Walk up to your Movement without spending a Card Play or Time. At the start of your turn, refill your Movement. Base Movement is 2.
keyword:item: A one-use card from your item slots.
An Item from either of your 2 slots joins your deck and has Consume.
combat:surface_techniques: Burst destroys ground and deals damage.

Frost Circuit leaves Electrified on the tile, then deals 2 damage and Shocks the enemy on the tile. On Ice, Frost Circuit does the same on each connected Ice tile. Discharge Bursts the Electrified tile and each connected Electrified tile. Wards leave ground on each adjacent enemy's tile. Ice gives Expose on entry and on turn start.
combat:sweeping_strikes: Hit each visible enemy that meets the named condition.
Select no target. The condition may require Fire, Ice, Electrified or Light. Each hit is a direct hit. Play the card only if at least 1 enemy qualifies and is within Range.
